t: This is Garden Corner, a house at 13 Chelsea Embankment in Chelsea. It's listed, which means it's protected for its historical and architectural value. The house was designed by Edward I'Anson, an architect who lived from 1811 to 1888. Look at it as a piece of the Embankment's frontage, one building among the others that line this stretch beside the river. I don't have much more to tell you about it than that, so take your time and enjoy the view.
